note: Signals are search terms for a reviewer, not classifications. A policy marked ASSUMED_CONJUNCTION has not been confirmed to be conjunctive - it means no signal was found by a lexical scan that cannot read meaning.

unresolved_semantics: UNRESOLVED: C03 (appropriate supervision level) references the supervision levels set out in paragraph (b)(3), which is not transcribed. The criterion therefore cannot be adjudicated on its own evidence - see R-51. Declared here as a plain conjunct because that is what the engine did before; whether it should instead be conditional on the test's designated level is a question for review, not for a guess.

UNRESOLVED: C04 (portable x-ray general supervision) applies only to portable x-ray services furnished in a place of residence used as the patient's home. That is conditional applicability, which this representation can express with `when`, but there is no transcribed criterion establishing whether a case IS a portable x-ray service. Declared as a plain conjunct, which over-applies it.

UNRESOLVED: whether the (a)(1) exception also relieves C02 (results used in management). The text relieves only the treating-physician requirement on its face, and it is read narrowly here. A narrow reading is the conservative one for approval and the aggressive one for denial, so it is flagged rather than settled.

UNRESOLVED: paragraph (a)(2) exempts four categories of diagnostic test from every paragraph these criteria are drawn from. It is declared here as a plain conjunction, which OVER-APPLIES the requirements to an exempt case. This is currently unreachable - R0075 is the only code linked to this version and it is in none of the four categories - so the over-application is latent rather than live. Linking any further code to this policy must re-open this note.

UNRESOLVED: (c)(1), the source of C04, opens "Except as otherwise stated in paragraph (c)(2)". (c)(2) sets a different qualification standard for services that need no direct or in-person beneficiary interaction. It is not transcribed, so C04 cannot be relieved by it and is declared as a plain conjunct. For R0075, a transport service, whether (c)(2) governs is precisely the kind of question this file must not answer by itself.

UNRESOLVED: C05 is typed EXCLUSION and reads as a limit on the SUPERVISING PHYSICIAN across sites - "no more than three IDTF sites" - rather than a property of the test being adjudicated. Under the decision table an established exclusion denies the request. Whether a supervisor's fourth site should deny an otherwise-compliant test, or should instead be a facility-level finding, is a coverage question and is left as it was transcribed rather than re-typed here.
